response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    o.dealedge AS side,
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
),
groups AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY orderslink, side
),
with_side_avg AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM groups
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  side,
  avg_net_fee_rate,
  record_count,
  avg_net_fee_rate - side_avg_net_fee_rate AS difference
FROM with_side_avg
WHERE avg_net_fee_rate > side_avg_net_fee_rate
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Missing fee rates or rebates yield a NULL net rate and are ignored by AVG; COUNT(*) still counts each qualifying matched fee record in its group, including records with a NULL net rate.
